draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Following up on our getting started call last week -- I know setup is easy to put off when the week fills up.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real Harbor Group project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to sit with you while you set up that first project.

Best,
Priya
